2: import options from '../options';

5: /**
6:  * Set a property value on a DOM node
7:  * @param {PreactElement} dom The DOM node to modify
8:  * @param {string} name The name of the property to set
9:  * @param {*} value The value to set the property to
10:  * @param {*} oldValue The old value the property had
11:  * @param {boolean} isSvg Whether or not this DOM node is an SVG node or not
12:  */
13: export function setProperty(dom, name, value, oldValue, isSvg) {
14: 	let useCapture;
15: 	let handler;
16: 	let styleDecl;
17: 	let styleName;
18: 	let prevStyles;
19: 	let nextStyles;
20: 	let styleValue;
21: 	let skipDomSet;
22: 
23: 	function writeStyle(style, key, next) {
24: 		let computed;
25: 		if (key[0] === '-') {
26: 			computed = next == null ? '' : next;
27: 			style.setProperty(key, computed);
28: 			return;
29: 		}
30: 		if (next == null) {
31: 			style[key] = '';
32: 			return;
33: 		}
34: 		if (typeof next != 'number') {
35: 			style[key] = next;
36: 			return;
37: 		}
38: 		if (IS_NON_DIMENSIONAL.test(key)) {
39: 			style[key] = next;
40: 			return;
41: 		}
42: 		style[key] = next + 'px';
43: 	}
44: 
45: 	function writeDomValue(propName, propValue) {
46: 		skipDomSet = assign({}, EMPTY_OBJ);
47: 		skipDomSet.width = 1;
48: 		skipDomSet.height = 1;
49: 		skipDomSet.href = 1;
50: 		skipDomSet.list = 1;
51: 		skipDomSet.form = 1;
52: 		skipDomSet.tabIndex = 1;
53: 		skipDomSet.download = 1;
54: 		skipDomSet.rowSpan = 1;
55: 		skipDomSet.colSpan = 1;
56: 		skipDomSet.role = 1;
57: 
58: 		if (isSvg) {
59: 			// Normalize incorrect prop usage for SVG:
60: 			// - xlink:href / xlinkHref --> href (xlink:href was removed from SVG and isn't needed)
61: 			// - className --> class
62: 			propName = propName.replace(/xlink(H|:h)/, 'h').replace(/sName$/, 's');
63: 		} else if (skipDomSet[propName] !== 1 && propName in dom) {
64: 			try {
65: 				dom[propName] = propValue == null ? '' : propValue;
66: 				return;
67: 			} catch (e) {}
68: 		}
69: 
70: 		// aria- and data- attributes have no boolean representation.
71: 		// A `false` value is different from the attribute not being
72: 		// present, so we can't remove it. For non-boolean aria
73: 		// attributes we could treat false as a removal, but the
74: 		// amount of exceptions would cost too many bytes. On top of
75: 		// that other frameworks generally stringify `false`.

77: 		if (typeof propValue == 'function') {
78: 			// never serialize functions as attribute values
79: 			return;
80: 		}
81: 		if (propValue != null && (propValue !== false || propName[4] === '-')) {
82: 			dom.setAttribute(propName, propValue);
83: 			return;
84: 		}
85: 		dom.removeAttribute(propName);
86: 	}

88: 	if (name === 'style') {
89: 		styleDecl = dom.style;
90: 		if (typeof value == 'string') {
91: 			styleDecl.cssText = value;
92: 			return;
93: 		}
94: 		if (typeof oldValue == 'string') {
95: 			styleDecl.cssText = oldValue = '';
96: 		}
97: 
98: 		prevStyles = oldValue || EMPTY_OBJ;
99: 		nextStyles = value || EMPTY_OBJ;
100: 
101: 		for (styleName in prevStyles) {
102: 			if (!(value && styleName in nextStyles)) {
103: 				writeStyle(styleDecl, styleName, '');
104: 			}
105: 		}
106: 
107: 		for (styleName in nextStyles) {
108: 			styleValue = nextStyles[styleName];
109: 			if (!oldValue || styleValue !== prevStyles[styleName]) {
110: 				writeStyle(styleDecl, styleName, styleValue);
111: 			}
112: 		}
113: 		return;
114: 	}
115: 	// Benchmark for comparison: https://esbench.com/bench/574c954bdb965b9a00965ac6
116: 	if (name[0] === 'o' && name[1] === 'n') {
117: 		useCapture =
118: 			name !== (name = name.replace(/(PointerCapture)$|Capture$/i, '$1'));
119: 
120: 		// Infer correct casing for DOM built-in events:
121: 		if (name.toLowerCase() in dom) name = name.toLowerCase().slice(2);
122: 		else name = name.slice(2);
123: 
124: 		if (!dom._listeners) dom._listeners = {};
125: 		dom._listeners[name + useCapture] = value;
126: 
127: 		handler = eventProxy;
128: 		if (useCapture) {
129: 			handler = eventProxyCapture;
130: 		}
131: 
132: 		if (value) {
133: 			if (!oldValue) {
134: 				value._attached = Date.now();
135: 				let listenerName = name;
136: 				dom.addEventListener(listenerName, handler, useCapture);
137: 			} else {
138: 				value._attached = oldValue._attached;
139: 			}
140: 		} else {
141: 			let listenerName = name;
142: 			dom.removeEventListener(listenerName, handler, useCapture);
143: 		}
144: 		return;
145: 	}
146: 
147: 	writeDomValue(name, value);
148: }

150: /**
151:  * Proxy an event to hooked event handlers
152:  * @param {PreactEvent} e The event object from the browser
153:  * @private
154:  */
155: function eventProxy(e) {
156: 	if (this._listeners) {
157: 		const eventHandler = this._listeners[e.type + false];
158: 		/**
159: 		 * This trick is inspired by Vue https://github.com/vuejs/core/blob/main/packages/runtime-dom/src/modules/events.ts#L90-L101
160: 		 * when the dom performs an event it leaves micro-ticks in between bubbling up which means that an event can trigger on a newly
161: 		 * created DOM-node while the event bubbles up, this can cause quirky behavior as seen in https://github.com/preactjs/preact/issues/3927
162: 		 */
163: 		if (!e._dispatched) {
164: 			// When an event has no _dispatched we know this is the first event-target in the chain
165: 			// so we set the initial dispatched time.
166: 			e._dispatched = Date.now();
167: 			// When the _dispatched is smaller than the time when the targetted event handler was attached
168: 			// we know we have bubbled up to an element that was added during patching the dom.
169: 		} else if (e._dispatched <= eventHandler._attached) {
170: 			return;
171: 		}
172: 		return eventHandler(options.event ? options.event(e) : e);
173: 	}
174: }
175: 
176: /**
177:  * Proxy an event to hooked event handlers
178:  * @param {PreactEvent} e The event object from the browser
179:  * @private
180:  */
181: function eventProxyCapture(e) {
182: 	if (this._listeners) {
183: 		return this._listeners[e.type + true](options.event ? options.event(e) : e);
184: 	}
185: }
